a: keyLegendFromKey prints modifier keys by their raw name, disagreeing with keyLegendFromCode
Legends ignore the `Esc` / `Space` aliases the matcher accepts
describeRoute prints raw target forms as nouns ("on a affordance:handle:nw", "on a selected-body")
ROUTE_FIELD_DEFINITIONS.target documents a target form routeToSpec rejects
fixedSeat treats a `filter` on the root element as a fixed containing block
A hover `leave` binding never fires when the pointer leaves its target with a button held
b: A two-finger tap is timed and travel-checked from the second finger's landing, so a brief second touch during a one-finger drag or after a long-press emits `multitouchtap`
Going from 2 to 3 fingers starts a new gesture without ending the old one; going from 3 back to 2 ends it and nothing restarts it
`fixedSeat` misses `transform-style: preserve-3d` (and `offset-path`) as containing blocks for fixed descendants
`formatShortcut` drops `shift: 'optional'` only on the key itself, not on its leader steps
`describeRoute` prints target forms verbatim after "a", and `ROUTE_FIELD_DEFINITIONS` describes the slots inaccurately
